result:
The fix is in the working tree but not committed or pushed (the repo has no remote), so the pipeline itself hasn't re-run yet.

- **Cause:** `Money.Format` relied on the host's `de-DE` culture data. On a machine running .NET in invariant-globalization mode, `de-DE` silently falls back to invariant separators, giving `1,234.50 €`. I reproduced the exact failure locally by building with `-p:InvariantGlobalization=true -p:PredefinedCulturesOnly=false`. That runner-05 is set up this way is inferred — I couldn't inspect the runner. The MR's own diff didn't touch `Format`.
- **Action:** Changed `src/Storefront/Invoices/Money.cs` to use an explicit `NumberFormatInfo` (`.` for thousands, `,` for decimals) instead of `CultureInfo.GetCultureInfo("de-DE")`. The test is unchanged. Money and Receipt tests pass in both normal and invariant mode; I did not run the rest of the suite.

Other culture-dependent code would still misbehave on runner-05, so its globalization setup is worth checking.
